criteria.summary: Current custody/CLI/malformed-key/error projection checks, daemon safe error paths, silent SDK/session logging, real AEAD no-plaintext export assertions and60-file exact-known-secret evidence scan. Actual outputs retain fixed booleans/public canonical values rather than keys. Limit: Exact occurrence scan and adversarial tests are bounded engineering evidence, not proof against every encoding/derived leak or all historical logs. Specialist/T03 privacy review remains separate.

Actual empty independent profile imports same key/full salt plus four portable journal records, restored owned name and canonical confirmed avatar workflow; original profile regular-file paths/content and backup unchanged. Current AEAD tests cover bad passwords/tamper/foreign ownership/newer local conflict/partial idempotent restore/uncertain no-replay, and custody tests reject active-wallet replacement. Limit: Actual import deliberately makes no new transaction. No real proof is required to validate this configuration-independent backup/import behavior; proof-dependent application acceptance remains elsewhere. Not a full-history/key-only reconstruction claim.

Actual natural cross-tab operation-lock refusal/release plus both origin-bound MetaMask tabs receive correct account-change events and invalidate; old contexts refuse export. Actual chain0x1 readback followed by both app invalidations, original account/31337 restored. Current controlled checks exercise context guards at initialization/read/send boundaries and cleanup-before-lock-release. Limit: Chain callback delivery/timing was not captured; no event-timing inference. Actual account event and actual chain state/subsequent invalidation are distinct evidence.

Actual UI shows encrypted backup/password no-reset, lost-key/raw-file warnings and backup freshness after random claims. d5 privacy wording accurately states trusted prover/query visibility. Source/docs distinguish browser unlocked-page/PXE limitations, full salts and scoped journals; legacy passkey/CLI routes remain applicable separately. Limit: No anonymity against arbitrary network/operator observers or specialist qualification claimed.
